mechanism.claim: When absolute five-minute open-interest changes occur synchronously with absolute BTC returns throughout a high-variation completed three-hour block, unusually high gross OI activity is sponsoring price discovery rather than merely changing the position stock. Follow the completed BTC direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed three-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVOIPCSR correlates magnitudes abs(dlog OI) and abs(five-minute return) within one completed block. HVOILSR correlated signed OI changes with later signed returns; GOICR compared net OI displacement with gross churn; HVLOIPSR measured when gross OI activity arrived inside an eight-hour block. This candidate uses neither OI direction, lead-lag, endpoint OI change, arrival share, funding, premium, flow, liquidations, cross-assets, prior event rows, fitted outcomes, nor prior controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed price variation and gross OI activity must both occupy causal upper regimes
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: eight fixed UTC magnitude-coactivity opportunities per day are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: exact UTC boundaries divisible by three hours
features.price_block: 36 exact coherent BTCUSDT five-minute bars aggregated from 180 unique one-minute rows in [D-3h,D)
features.oi_path: 37 exact unique positive BTCUSDT period=5m observations at D-3h,...,D; final observation timestamp<=D and all inputs precede exact D+5m entry; no imputation
features.coactivity: Pearson correlation(abs(d_i),abs(r_i)), requiring finite nonzero variance in both vectors
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of coactivity, gross OI activity, and realized variation over at most 720 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 504; current excluded
features.eligibility: coactivity rank>=0.75, gross-OI-activity rank>=0.60, and variation rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: synchronous magnitude coupling of leverage activity and price discovery

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, comparator, or control repair.
